test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option:

Neither the director nor the senior analysts ______ inclined to support the merger in its proposed form.
solution:
The correct answer is '**were**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of the sentence is a compound subject connected by "neither...nor," where the verb agrees with the closest subject ("senior analysts").
 
• Since "senior analysts" is plural, the verb "were" is the correct choice.
